entities.summary: Nika Roza Danilova, known professionally by her stage name Zola Jesus, is an American singer, songwriter, and record producer. Her music has been noted for combining elements of electronic, industrial, classical, and goth. She is also the cousin of United States Senator Amy Klobuchar.
